deities.name: Horundar
deities.rationale: Earthquakes, storms, water, and raw elemental force make Horundar the broadest patron of Panolima elemental harmony.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Marduthor
deities.rationale: Earth and fire bloodlines honor transformation through stone, heat, craft, and controlled material change.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Bastveig
deities.rationale: Water bloodlines and ocean communities recognize Bastveig’s authority over tides and hidden waters.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Sokhivar
deities.rationale: Air, magical light, and sky-facing aether traditions place part of Panolima worship under Sokhivar.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
